overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: referring complaints to counsel could be noted on the notice, and amended notices showing their amendment date and time were not an error.

allegations.summary: Complaint said the Oct. 26 notice improperly stated the Board would refer two identified complaints to Town Counsel, before reviewing them in a meeting.
allegations.key_passage: As we have explained to the complainant on numerous occasions, a public body may choose to refer a complaint to legal counsel during a meeting, rather than discuss its substance.

allegations.summary: Complaint said two amended notices for the Oct. 26 meeting still carried the original posting notation and date of 10/24/23.
allegations.key_passage: We find no error, where the notices also indicated the date and time of the amendments.
